material_findings.claim: Connected head construction remains the highest-value visible correction, and the plan names its defining relationships.
material_findings.evidence: Freshly viewed saved images retain a smooth pale cap, prominent external optic ring, sparse dark crown forms and open cheek void/smooth rails. Source crown sweep, layered brow/recess, cheek negative space and hooked bill are connected into one compact severe head. Tasks T001–T007 require this assembly relationship, both profiles and whole-bird review, avoiding a tint-only substitute.
material_findings.consequence: Separate local adjustments could produce a better close-up fragment while the inherited bird still misses its defining source identity.
material_findings.next_test: One authorized integrated head successor with source-feature plan, both-side/three-quarter head pairs and unchanged-camera complete-bird comparison in 15–30 minutes, then mandatory eight-view postflight before recommendation.

material_findings.claim: Whole-character and all-three-era coverage is specific enough to guide useful work without extending reference authority.
material_findings.evidence: Breast/wing plate character, leg hardware and compact claw profiles remain secondary gaps after the head. T011 now correctly targets broader/shorter/more curved source claws while retaining toe joints. Maker/Mechanic finish similarity and Advanced inherited upgrades have separate tasks; dark early optics and restrained Advanced orange remain explicit. T013 freezes seven reference scopes/hashes. Locked full-bird canon, prior candidate03 body direction, July head-only identity and era finish references are distinguishable; July body/hanging wings and surrounding props do not become geometry mandates.
material_findings.consequence: A common finish filter, mirrored chronology or borrowing July's body could erase era identity and the accepted compact full-bird direction.
material_findings.next_test: All-era source/candidate regional and whole-bird sheets under neutral/exhibit lighting, supported-versus-inferred notes for opposite/rear forms and source-scoped repair/upgrade decisions. First Choice timecodes/frame hashes remain required before claiming video continuity; this role did not play that video.

material_findings.claim: The four requested PASS01 corrections are present and improve implementation readiness.
material_findings.evidence: T001 explicitly depends on T062; implementation tasks carry the cap prerequisite. dispatch_contract requires named contributors and exact owned files/objects/source base before implementation. T015 separates executable retained-custody preflight from successor comparison postflight. T001 and series postflight gates make T014 all-era eight-angle/same-camera whole-bird/detail evidence mandatory before recommending a checkpoint. Shared 45-minute/12,000-token head packet caps are not summed per-task allocations.
material_findings.consequence: These controls prevent premature dispatch, self-blocking preservation evidence and promotion from a single favorable hero view.
material_findings.next_test: Before execution, inspect the actual selected-task assignment ledger and harmless monitor/stop drill; after creation, inspect the exact eight-view and retained-gain comparison files. Their specification is not proof that they have run.

material_findings.claim: The connected-head prerequisite still conflates authorization/feature planning with finished-head acceptance.
material_findings.evidence: T001's closure includes exact head assembly, whole-bird comparison and mandatory successor eight-view/preservation postflight. T002–T005 depend on T001 but only restrict T062, not the T001 edge, to a preflight slice. The dependency graph is syntactically acyclic, yet interpreting a dependency as full task closure would require the finished head before the tasks constructing it. The new global rule promises explicit slice restrictions for mixed pre/postflight tasks, making this ambiguity consequential.
material_findings.consequence: A competent executor could stall waiting for impossible prerequisite evidence or complete an unowned head separately before the connected corrections begin.
material_findings.next_test: Add T001 scope_slices and restrict downstream T001 edges to owner-selected bounded scope/source-feature plan/assembly ownership only. Keep assembled-head and eight-view evidence as postflight acceptance. A paper walk-through should reach T002/T004 dispatch before any successor model exists.

material_findings.claim: The roadmap retains complete criterion coverage and honest acceptance limits, but its continuation metadata trails this freeze.
material_findings.evidence: Independent PRD table extraction again matches all 52 IDs with no missing/extra map IDs. F01–F10 remain mapped; source goal UNMET, owner PENDING, static CG versus V37 and conditional later phases remain preserved. next_root_action still instructs completion of PASS01 and freezing PASS02, despite the current PASS02 freeze; validation.formal_passes_run stays 0 while formal_review_passes_completed_by_this_draft is 1. These fields should identify their historical or current meaning.
material_findings.consequence: A continuation reader could repeat a completed review step or misunderstand the number of completed formal passes.
material_findings.next_test: Refresh next_root_action for PASS02 adjudication/PASS03 freezing and label or synchronize the formal-pass metadata after root saves decisive records. No future five-pass completion is inferred.
